conbody.p: You can place reflector triangle and etc. under the luggage board.

li.p: Grasp the handle on the top of the cover and lift it.
Fold the rear part of luggage board frontward.
Lift up luggage board frontward. (Luggage board stand itself)

section.title: Increase cargo space
section.p: If you want to increase cargo space:

li.p: Grasp the handle on the top of the cover and lift it.
Fold the rear part of the luggage board frontward.
Pull the luggage board hinge to the end of sliding slot and it will fall down lower to increase cargo space.
Slide it frontward (refer to the above pictures).

section.title: Using the luggage board in the open position
section.p: When loading tall cargo or dividing the cargo area, the luggage board can be folded into two sections to form a prism (triangular) shape.

li.p: Grasp the handle attached to the upper board in the cargo area and lift it upward toward the front.
Continue lifting the handle in a forward rotating motion. The upper board will fold into two sections, forming a triangular structure.
Make sure the board is securely positioned and stable.

section.p: To return the luggage board to its original position, follow the above procedure in reverse order.

li.p: When folding or unfolding the board, keep your fingers and other body parts away from the folding areas to avoid injury.

p.b: Do not place heavy objects on the folded board

li.p: Do not place heavy items on the board when it is folded into a triangular shape. Doing so may damage the board or cause items to fall during driving.
Do not drive the vehicle with the board positioned insecurely. During sudden braking, the board may unfold or generate noise.
